class ConfigFileProcessor:
    def __init__(self, config_file, api_url):
        self.config_file = config_file
        self.api_url = api_url

    async def fetch_values(self):

def adjust_chunk_size(memory_percentage):

async def process_lines(file, chunk_size, error_messages):
